sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是“99%隐形”播客。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: On the show this week, we're bringing you an episode of a new podcast called La Brega.
sentences.zh: 在本周的节目中，我们将为您带来一档名为《拉布雷加》（La Brega）的新播客节目。

sentences.en: And to tell us about this series is Alana Casanova-Burgis.
sentences.zh: 今天做客节目、为我们介绍这个系列的是阿拉娜·卡萨诺瓦-布尔吉斯。

sentences.en: Host and co-creator and producer of La Brega, Stories of the Puerto Rican Experience,
sentences.zh: 她是《拉布雷加：波多黎各人经历的故事》的主持人、联合创始人和制作人，

sentences.en: co-production from WNYC Studios and Futuro Studios.
sentences.zh: 该节目由WNYC工作室与未来工作室联合制作。

sentences.en: I say that in my dreams now.
sentences.zh: 我现在做梦都在说这句话。

sentences.en: The name of the show, La Brega, is a word in Puerto Rican Spanish that doesn't really
sentences.zh: 节目的名字《拉布雷加》（La Brega），是波多黎各西班牙语中的一个词，在英语中

sentences.en: have a great English translation.
sentences.zh: 很难找到一个完美的翻译。

sentences.en: But to illustrate the concept, we're going to start with a cell phone video that was taken
sentences.zh: 但为了说明这个概念，我们要从一段手机视频开始讲起，

sentences.en: in the aftermath of Hurricane Maria, when the people of Puerto Rico were living in the dark.
sentences.zh: 这段视频拍摄于玛丽亚飓风过后，当时波多黎各人民生活在一片黑暗之中。

sentences.en: Some Puerto Ricans were without electricity for months on end, and everyone had to find
sentences.zh: 一些波多黎各人连续几个月用不上电，每个人都不得不寻找

sentences.en: ways to cope.
sentences.zh: 应对困境的方法。

sentences.en: And in the video, two people are standing in a carport.
sentences.zh: 视频里，两个人正站在一个车棚里。

sentences.en: And so a woman is recording her father, and they're showing off this invention.
sentences.zh: 一个女人在拍她的父亲，他们正在展示一项发明。

sentences.en: They've got like the body, the drum of a washing machine.
sentences.zh: 他们用的是洗衣机的机身和内筒。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: And then in the middle, what do you call that?
sentences.zh: 然后中间那个，那个叫什么来着？

sentences.en: The like spoke that comes out of the middle of the washing machine.
sentences.zh: 就像洗衣机中间伸出来的那个搅拌轴。

sentences.en: The agitator, the spinner or something?
sentences.zh: 搅拌器，旋转器什么的？

sentences.en: The agitator, that is correct.
sentences.zh: 搅拌器，没错。

sentences.en: I think I had Googled that at one point.
sentences.zh: 我想我之前还用谷歌查过这个词。

sentences.en: The agitator has bicycle handlebars attached to it.
sentences.zh: 这个搅拌器上装了自行车的车把。

sentences.en: And this woman's father is so excited to show off this bici lavadora.
sentences.zh: 这个女人的父亲兴奋极了，急着展示这台“自行车洗衣机”。

sentences.en: So he's, you know, he's moving the handlebars back and forth and showing how it froths up,
sentences.zh: 所以你看，他把车把前后推来推去，展示着它是怎么起泡沫的，

sentences.en: how you get like a good lather in the soap.
sentences.zh: 肥皂是怎么打出丰富的泡沫的。

sentences.en: And they're just making like the most of this terrible situation.
sentences.zh: 他们只是在尽最大努力苦中作乐。

sentences.en: So they're exclaiming like, look, it washes so well.
sentences.zh: 所以他们大声惊叹，看啊，洗得真干净。

sentences.en: You don't have electricity, but you don't need it.
sentences.zh: 虽然没有电，但你根本不需要电。

sentences.en: And you get a workout while you're doing it.
sentences.zh: 而且在洗衣服的同时还能锻炼身体。

sentences.en: And they're just like having a funny time.
sentences.zh: 他们过得还挺开心的。

sentences.en: You know, Puerto Ricans are really creative.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，波多黎各人真的很有创造力。

sentences.en: I know everybody says that about themselves.
sentences.zh: 我知道每个人都会这么标榜自己。

sentences.en: We're such a creative people.
sentences.zh: 我们是如此富有创造力的民族。

sentences.en: But you're all wrong is the thing.
sentences.zh: 但事实是，你们都说错了。

sentences.en: Look, low-key flex, but we've been through a lot.
sentences.zh: 听着，虽然有点低调炫耀的意思，但我们确实经历了很多。

sentences.en: And so there's this sort of celebration in the video.
sentences.zh: 所以在视频里有一种庆祝的氛围。

sentences.en: And then at the same time, I knew, like I knew from talking to my own family members,
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，我知道，从我和自己家人的交谈中我深有体会，

sentences.en: how raw your hands get from like washing everything by hand in water,
sentences.zh: 亲手在水里洗所有东西会让双手变得多么粗糙刺痛，

sentences.en: how like everybody just had to do the most for months.
sentences.zh: 每个人都不得不咬牙坚持好几个月。

sentences.en: Like my aunt didn't have electricity for nine months, right?
sentences.zh: 就像我姑姑有九个月都没电用，对吧？

sentences.en: So they can't get power back for themselves.
sentences.zh: 所以他们无法自己恢复供电。

sentences.en: They can't like reconnect the electricity because the infrastructure is so poor
sentences.zh: 他们没法重新接通电源，因为基础设施太差了，

sentences.en: and the government is failing them.
sentences.zh: 政府也让他们失望了。

sentences.en: But they find this workaround so that their hands don't have to like crack after weeks
sentences.zh: 但他们找到了这种权宜之计，这样他们的双手就不会在经历了数周

sentences.en: and then what will become months of washing your laundry by hand.
sentences.zh: 乃至后来长达数月的手洗衣服后彻底裂开。

sentences.en: And so when I was thinking about how to describe the name of the series,
sentences.zh: 所以，当我考虑如何向听众描述这个系列的名字

sentences.en: La Brega, to listeners, one of the first things that popped up
sentences.zh: 《拉布雷加》（La Brega）时，浮现在我脑海的第一件事

sentences.en: was this YouTube video that I had watched like three years ago.
sentences.zh: 就是我大约三年前看过的一个YouTube视频。

sentences.en: So what is La Brega?
sentences.zh: 那么，什么是“拉布雷加”？

sentences.en: Can you define it for us?
sentences.zh: 你能为我们定义一下吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: It is a word that Puerto Ricans use.
sentences.zh: 这是波多黎各人常用的一个词。

sentences.en: We use it all the time.
sentences.zh: 我们无时无刻不在用它。

sentences.en: It's this like catch-all word for I'm struggling with something.
sentences.zh: 这是一个包罗万象的词，意思是“我在与某事苦苦挣扎”。

sentences.en: I'm in the hustle.
sentences.zh: 我在为生活奔波拼搏。

sentences.en: I'm in the situation that I can't solve.
sentences.zh: 我陷入了一种无法解决的困境。

sentences.en: I can't actually like have any resolution to it, right?
sentences.zh: 我实际上根本无法找到任何解决办法，对吧？

sentences.en: So for example, you can't solve the problem that you don't have electricity.
sentences.zh: 比如，你无法解决没电的问题。

sentences.en: But you can like attach some bicycle handlebars to the agitator of your washing machine
sentences.zh: 但你可以在洗衣机的搅拌器上装上自行车车把，

sentences.en: and you can kind of make do.
sentences.zh: 然后你就可以凑合着过下去。

sentences.en: Maybe you have a terrible boss.
sentences.zh: 也许你遇到了一个糟糕的老板。

sentences.en: You can't fix that problem.
sentences.zh: 你无法解决这个问题。

sentences.en: You can't resolve it, but you're like, all right, I'm just like I'm grappling with it.
sentences.zh: 你无法摆脱它，但你会想，好吧，我只能硬着头皮跟它周旋。

sentences.en: I think grappling is a good one.
sentences.zh: 我觉得“周旋”这个词挺贴切的。

sentences.en: But we use it all the time.
sentences.zh: 但我们一直在用这个词。

sentences.en: And I think I only really realized this after Maria.
sentences.zh: 我想我是在玛丽亚飓风之后才真正意识到这一点的。

sentences.en: I was reporting for On the Media and I was able to actually make a montage of,
sentences.zh: 当时我正在为《关于媒体》（On the Media）节目做报道，我实际上剪辑了一个蒙太奇，

sentences.en: I was asking people like, how are you doing though?
sentences.zh: 我当时问大家：“不过，你们过得怎么样？”

sentences.en: Like, but how are you doing really?
sentences.zh: “但是，你们真的过得怎么样？”

sentences.en: Which is a hard question to ask whenever, but like nobody really wants to get into their feelings
sentences.zh: 无论什么时候这都是个很难回答的问题，但其实没人愿意触及自己的情绪，

sentences.en: because how do you then crawl out of them?
sentences.zh: 因为一旦陷进去，又该怎么爬出来呢？

sentences.en: And people would say like, oh, you know, you got to get used to it.
sentences.zh: 人们会说：“哦，你知道的，你得习惯它。”

sentences.en: Hay que acostumbrarse.
sentences.zh: （西班牙语：Hay que acostumbrarse.）

sentences.en: And I was like, wow, we get used to things.
sentences.zh: 当时我想，哇，我们还真是什么都能习惯。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Like a lot.
sentences.zh: 真的习惯了好多。

sentences.en: And that doesn't seem entirely healthy all the time.
sentences.zh: 而且这看起来好像并不完全是什么健康的常态。

sentences.en: And there's this like celebration of resilience.
sentences.zh: 这里有一种对韧性的颂扬。

sentences.en: Like, oh, Puerto Ricans are so resilient.
sentences.zh: 就像，“哦，波多黎各人太有韧性了。”

sentences.en: We're so resilient.
sentences.zh: “我们太顽强了。”

sentences.en: But like, why are we resilient?
sentences.zh: 但是，我们为什么要这么顽强呢？

sentences.en: And then then comes that word.
sentences.zh: 然后，这个词就出现了。

sentences.en: Like, how are you doing?
sentences.zh: 比如，“你最近怎么样？”

sentences.en: Well, aquí en la brega, bregando.
sentences.zh: “嗯，就在这里苦熬着，挣扎着呗。”

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: That's that you're also just coping and hustling and grappling with something instead of resolving, solving it.
sentences.zh: 这就是说，你只是在应付、奔波，在与某些事情纠缠，而不是去真正解决它。

sentences.en: I mean, this is evidence in the fact that, you know, we have to talk for a long time to define this thing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这从一个事实中就能看出，你知道的，我们需要花很长时间来定义这个词。

sentences.en: That it's kind of hard to define in English.
sentences.zh: 它在英语中很难被定义。

sentences.en: Like there isn't like a, you know, an easy equivalent.
sentences.zh: 就好像没有一个，你知道的，简单易懂的对应词。

sentences.en: What do you think that is?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这是为什么？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: But I would love to loan this word.
sentences.zh: 但我很想借用这个词。

sentences.en: Like what has the pandemic been if not for like one long brega?
sentences.zh: 回想一下，大流行不就是一场漫长的“拉布雷加”吗？

sentences.en: Fair.
sentences.zh: 有道理。

sentences.en: Yeah, totally.
sentences.zh: 没错，完全是这样。

sentences.en: So you've made a whole podcast series called La Brega.
sentences.zh: 所以你制作了一个名为《拉布雷加》的完整播客系列。

sentences.en: Tell us what motivated you to make it and what you wanted to accomplish with the series.
sentences.zh: 跟我们讲讲是什么促使你制作了它，以及你希望通过这个系列实现什么目标。

sentences.en: We wanted to tell really rich, beautifully told stories about a place that really doesn't get talked about very often on our own terMs.
sentences.zh: 我们想要以我们自己的方式，讲述关于一个鲜少被提及的地方的丰富、优美的故事。

sentences.en: You know, we hear about whether it should be a state, what the Democrats want, what the Republicans want.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们听到的总是关于它是否应该成为一个州、民主党人想要什么、共和党人想要什么。

sentences.en: But very rarely are we talking about our own experience with, for example, austerity policy.
sentences.zh: 但我们极少谈论我们自己对诸如紧缩政策等问题的亲身经历。

sentences.en: You know, like what does that look like?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那到底是什么样的？

sentences.en: What does our own history look like?
sentences.zh: 我们自己的历史是怎样的？

sentences.en: Why do our suburbs look the way they do?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们的郊区是现在这个样子？

sentences.en: Just like making everything about ourselves.
sentences.zh: 总之就是把一切都聚焦于我们自身。

sentences.en: And so, you know, we put together this team.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我们组建了这样一个团队。

sentences.en: We've got musicians and artists and reporters and producers and editors who are both from the diaspora and from the island because, you know, it is a really complicated identity.
sentences.zh: 我们的成员包括音乐家、艺术家、记者、制作人和编辑，他们有的是离散海外的波多黎各人，有的是岛上居民，因为，你知道的，这是一种非常复杂的身份认同。

sentences.en: And so we wanted to marry those two parts of ourselves together and make like one team, like one Avengers squad.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们希望将我们身上的这两部分结合在一起，组成一个团队，就像复仇者联盟一样。

sentences.en: And at the same time, we wanted to talk to ourselves, obviously.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，显然我们也是在对我们自己诉说。

sentences.en: And so early on in production, we realized like we've got to make these episodes in both English and Spanish so that we don't leave anybody out.
sentences.zh: 所以在制作初期，我们就意识到：我们必须用英语和西班牙语双语制作这些节目，这样才不会落下任何人。

sentences.en: That's so cool.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: So like if you go to the La Brega feed, you will find English language and Spanish language versions.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你访问《拉布雷加》的节目源，你会发现英语版和西班牙语版。

sentences.en: They're side by side.
sentences.zh: 它们并排放在一起。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对的。

sentences.en: You can pick the one you want to listen to.
sentences.zh: 你可以选择你想听的那一个版本。

sentences.en: We've been hearing that a lot of people listen to both of them and then find like the Easter eggs, like the details that change.
sentences.zh: 我们听说很多人两个版本都听，然后寻找所谓的彩蛋，也就是那些发生变化的细节。

sentences.en: That are different between them.
sentences.zh: 也就是它们之间的不同之处。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Or couples where one person speaks one language better than the other.
sentences.zh: 或者有些伴侣，其中一个人对某门语言的掌握比另一个人更好。

sentences.en: They listen together and then discuss.
sentences.zh: 他们会一起收听，然后进行讨论。

sentences.en: I love it.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: I love it too.
sentences.zh: 我也很喜欢。

sentences.en: The stories that you made for the series and fittingly to 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 你为这个系列制作的故事，也非常契合“99%隐形”的风格。

sentences.en: It's the one about the Levittown in Puerto Rico, sort of the built environment story of the series.
sentences.zh: 那是关于波多黎各莱维特镇的故事，可以说是该系列中关于人造环境的故事。

sentences.en: So to start, what is Levittown and what's your family's connection to the place?
sentences.zh: 那么首先，什么是莱维特镇？你的家庭和这个地方有什么渊源？

sentences.en: Well, we say Levittown, but it's spelled the same way as Levittown in New York, say, on Long Island.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们叫它莱维特镇（Levittown），但它的拼写方式和纽约长岛的那个莱维特镇是一样的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And for people who don't know, Levittown's were these mass-produced suburbs.
sentences.zh: 对于不了解的人来说，莱维特镇是这种批量生产的郊区。

sentences.en: They're like kind of the model suburbs.
sentences.zh: 它们可以说是标准郊区的样板。

sentences.en: And there's one in New York and there's one in Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 纽约有一个，宾夕法尼亚州也有一个。

sentences.en: And it was news to me that there's one in Puerto Rico too.
sentences.zh: 而波多黎各居然也有一个，这对我来说是个新鲜事。

sentences.en: So...
sentences.zh: 所以……

sentences.en: Built by the same company.
sentences.zh: 由同一家公司建造。

sentences.en: Built by the same company.
sentences.zh: 由同一家公司建造。

sentences.en: Can you tell us a little bit about the Levittowns in general and what they were made?
sentences.zh: 你能给我们简单讲讲一般的莱维特镇，以及它们是为何建造的吗？

sentences.en: What the point of Levittowns were in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在美国和波多黎各，建造莱维特镇的初衷分别是什么？

sentences.en: and Puerto Rico?
sentences.zh: 我认为它们在波多黎各的目的略有不同。

sentences.en: I think that their purpose was slightly different in Puerto Rico.
sentences.zh: 但在纽约，它们的目的是为返乡退伍军人提供战后廉价住房，基本上就是这样。

sentences.en: But in New York, their purpose was post-war cheap housing for returning veterans, essentially.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你可以沿着一条新高速公路去往你的新房子，房子的建造方式完全一模一样。

sentences.en: You know, you could take a new highway out to your new house that was going to be built in exactly the same way.
sentences.zh: 你会有两三间卧室，如果有需要的话还可以再加一间。

sentences.en: You were going to have like a couple bedrooms, but you could add another one if you needed.
sentences.zh: 你会有崭新的家用电器，你的孩子会有新的学校、水塔、图书馆、警察局，应有尽有。

sentences.en: You'd have brand new appliances, and you would have a new school for your kids, a water tower, a library, police, the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 所以这些基本上就是凭空空降的社区。

sentences.en: So they were just these plopped-down communities, basically.
sentences.zh: 五年前，这里还是纽约长岛上一大片棋盘格般的马铃薯农场。

sentences.en: Five years ago, this was a vast checkerboard of potato farms on New York's Long Island.
sentences.zh: 如今，这里是一个拥有6万人口、1.5万栋房屋的社区，全部由一家公司建造。

sentences.en: Today, a community of 60,000 persons living in 15,000 homes, all built by one firm.
sentences.zh: 这就是莱维特镇。

sentences.en: This is Levittown.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，关于它们的其中一点，除了它们那种千篇一律的流水线制造模式之外，

sentences.en: You know, one of the things about them, beyond their sort of cookie-cutter manufacturing way that they existed,
sentences.zh: “这类房屋的特点之一，除了它们那种千篇一律的流水线批量制造方式之外，”

sentences.en: is that they pioneered some restrictive housing covenants.
sentences.zh: 就是他们率先搞了一些限制性的住房契约。

sentences.en: You were not allowed to be a person of color or a black person in a Levittown in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在美国的莱威镇，你是不被允许作为一个有色人种或黑人居住的。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And I think about this a little bit with the Levittown in Puerto Rico, is that in a way, you had, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且我稍微联想到波多黎各的莱威镇时就会发现，在某种程度上，你知道的，

sentences.en: you had all these migrants coming from the island to New York, and you had a lot of white flight into the suburbs,
sentences.zh: 有所有这些从岛上来到纽约的移民，同时也有大量白人逃离到郊区，

sentences.en: away from Puerto Ricans, away from people like my relatives, my family.
sentences.zh: 远离波多黎各人，远离像我亲戚、我家人这样的人。

sentences.en: And then when Puerto Ricans went back to the island in this wave of reverse migration in the late 60s and 70s,
sentences.zh: 然后，当波多黎各人在6年代末和7年代初的这波逆向移民潮中回到岛上时，

sentences.en: the company then sold us houses.
sentences.zh: 这家公司就把房子卖给我们了。

sentences.en: So it's like, yeah, they made money twice.
sentences.zh: 所以就像是，没错，他们赚了两次钱。

sentences.en: And my grandparents moved there when they moved from the Bronx back to the island in the early 70s.
sentences.zh: 我祖父母在7年代初从布朗克斯搬回岛上时就搬到了那里。

sentences.en: They are from another part of the island called Cialis, which is up in the mountains.
sentences.zh: 他们来自岛上的另一个地方叫西亚莱斯，位于山区。

sentences.en: It is beautiful.
sentences.zh: 那里非常美丽。

sentences.en: The views are gorgeous.
sentences.zh: 景色壮丽。

sentences.en: There are streaMs.
sentences.zh: 有溪流。

sentences.en: There are waterfalls.
sentences.zh: 有瀑布。

sentences.en: There are underground rivers.
sentences.zh: 有地下河。

sentences.en: It's so beautiful.
sentences.zh: 太美了。

sentences.en: And my aunt lives there.
sentences.zh: 我姑妈就住在那里。

sentences.en: And I could never understand as a kid why I would have to visit Levittown, which is a...
sentences.zh: 我小时候永远无法理解，为什么我非得去参观莱威镇，那是一个……

sentences.en: Which is not that, I take it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那可不是那样。

sentences.en: Which is not that.
sentences.zh: 那可不是那样。

sentences.en: It is a lot of concrete.
sentences.zh: 那里有大量的混凝土。

sentences.en: I mean, there's a beautiful mango tree in the front, but it's still, like, it's no Cialis.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，前院有一棵漂亮的芒果树，但它依然，怎么说呢，根本比不上西亚莱斯。

sentences.en: And it is so hot and so flat.
sentences.zh: 而且又热又平坦。

sentences.en: But at the same time, it's sort of, like, beautiful in its way.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，它以自己的方式也算得上是美丽。

sentences.en: In what way is it beautiful?
sentences.zh: 它在哪个方面美丽？

sentences.en: I mean, the houses all came in either, like, white or a cream color.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这些房子全都是白色或者乳白色的。

sentences.en: Like, they had no color.
sentences.zh: 就像它们没有别的颜色一样。

sentences.en: And unlike the houses in the New York Levittown, these are, like, all cement.
sentences.zh: 与纽约莱威镇的房子不同，这里的房子全都是水泥筑成的。

sentences.en: So you can paint, like, every surface of them.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以粉刷它们的每一个表面。

sentences.en: And so they can sometimes be quite colorful.
sentences.zh: 因此它们有时会变得相当色彩斑斓。

sentences.en: You kind of get these, like, sherbet colors.
sentences.zh: 你会看到这种类似果子露般的颜色。

sentences.en: And people also change them a lot.
sentences.zh: 而且人们也对它们进行了很多改造。

sentences.en: You know, like, added a second story.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，比如加盖了第二层。

sentences.en: Added some Trinitatia, which is a kind of bougainvillea.
sentences.zh: 添加了一些九重葛，也就是一种三角梅。

sentences.en: Like, they added personality to it.
sentences.zh: 就像是，他们为它增添了个性。

sentences.en: So why did you want to make this story?
sentences.zh: 那你为什么想做这个故事？

sentences.en: Like, what does the Levittown in Puerto Rico represent to you?
sentences.zh: 波多黎各的莱威镇对你来说代表着什么？

sentences.en: Someone else says this in the piece, but I'm going to steal it.
sentences.zh: 作品里有其他人这么说过，但我打算借用一下。

sentences.en: But it's sort of Puerto Rico in a nutshell.
sentences.zh: 但这有点像是波多黎各的缩影。

sentences.en: Like, you have this boom and bust story about this desire for modernity and for middle class success and the American dream.
sentences.zh: 就像你拥有这样一个关于渴望现代性、中产阶级成功以及美国梦的繁荣与萧条的故事。

sentences.en: But also this buSt.
sentences.zh: 但同时也是这种萧条。

sentences.en: There's so many foreclosures, so many empty homes.
sentences.zh: 有那么多的止赎房屋，那么多的空置住宅。

sentences.en: It's so hard to find a job that pays enough to have a house.
sentences.zh: 要找到一份薪水足以买得起房子的工作实在是太难了。

sentences.en: And so it sort of follows that boom and bust idea, but it also is about negotiating this desire for a kind of Puerto Rican success,
sentences.zh: 所以它有点顺应了那种繁荣与萧条的理念，但它也关乎协调对某种波多黎各式成功的渴望，

sentences.en: like this nostalgia for the mountains and for having chickens in a farm.
sentences.zh: 比如这种对山峦以及在农场养鸡的怀旧之情。

sentences.en: You know, you've got your backyard, but you also have this successful modernity that my family must have really craved, I think.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你有了后院，但你同时也拥有了这种我猜我的家人一定非常渴望的成功现代性。

sentences.en: Like, so that I just wanted to look into that and figure out why it exists and what it did for people, what it does for people.
sentences.zh: 所以，我只是想深入了解这一点，弄清楚它为什么存在，它为人们做了什么，它在为人们做什么。

sentences.en: Okay, so we're going to play the piece now.
sentences.zh: 好的，现在我们要播放这段音频。

sentences.en: This is the English version of episode two of La Brega.
sentences.zh: 这是《拉布雷加》（La Brega）第二集的英文版。

sentences.en: It's called Levittown, where the good life begins.
sentences.zh: 它叫《莱威镇，美好生活开始的地方》。

sentences.en: And we're going to start a few minutes in with the backstory of how the Levittown company came to develop land in Puerto Rico.
sentences.zh: 我们将从几分钟后的背景故事开始，讲讲莱威镇公司是如何在波多黎各开发土地的。

sentences.en: Instead of a potato field, in Puerto Rico, the company started out in 1962 by buying nearly 440 acres of flat swampland in the town of Tuabaja, about 20 minutes from San Juan.
sentences.zh: 在波多黎各，这里原本不是土豆田，该公司于1962年通过购买托阿瓦哈镇（Tua Baja）近440英亩的平坦沼泽地起家，这里距离圣胡安大约20分钟车程。

sentences.en: They built drainage canals to empty into an artificial lake.
sentences.zh: 他们修建了排洪沟，将水排入一个人工湖。

sentences.en: I've seen the engineering diagrams, and they're impressive.
sentences.zh: 我见过工程图纸，它们令人印象深刻。

sentences.en: They originally planned to build 3,000 homes, but by 1977, there would be over 11,000.
sentences.zh: 他们最初计划建造3000套住房，但到1977年，数量将超过11000套。

sentences.en: And just a short walk from the beach, they sold out quickly.
sentences.zh: 而且距离海滩仅几步之遥，房屋很快就售罄了。

sentences.en: The first models offered were Broche de Oro, El Camafeo, La Diadema, La Alaja, and La Esmeralda,
sentences.zh: 首批推出的户型有金胸针（Broche de Oro）、美化石（El Camafeo）、头饰（La Diadema）、首饰（La Alaja）和祖母绿（La Esmeralda），

sentences.en: the one with two stories, which my grandparents purchased from friends when they decided to leave the Bronx in the early 70s and come back home.
sentences.zh: 也就是那栋两层的房子，我祖父母在7年代初决定离开布朗克斯回家时，向朋友买下了它。

sentences.en: Or at least to a new home.
sentences.zh: 或者至少是搬到了一个新家。

sentences.en: Here in Levittown, the tagline was Donde La Buena Vida Comienza, where the good life begins.
sentences.zh: 在这里的莱威镇，标语是“美好生活开始的地方”（Donde La Buena Vida Comienza）。

sentences.en: Sí, esta casa es la cama feo.
sentences.zh: 是的，这房子就是美化石户型。

sentences.en: Cama feo, okay.
sentences.zh: 美化石，好的。

sentences.en: Ajá, cama feo.
sentences.zh: 对，美化石。

sentences.en: Hilda Rodríguez lives in a cama feo model with her daughter, Paola.
sentences.zh: 希ilda·罗德里格斯（Hilda Rodríguez）和她的女儿宝拉（Paola）住在一个美化石户型的房子里。

sentences.en: Hilda was five when they moved in in 1964.
sentences.zh: 1964年他们搬进来时，希尔达才五岁。

sentences.en: Sí, en el 64.
sentences.zh: 是的，在64年。

sentences.en: Nosotros fuimos, no sé si fuimos como los segundos o terceros en mudarnos aquí en Levittown.
sentences.zh: 我们当时是，我不知道我们是不是第二或第三个搬到莱威镇这里的人。

sentences.en: Perhaps just the second or third family there.
sentences.zh: 或许是那里的第二或第三个家庭。

sentences.en: Pionero, bien pionero.
sentences.zh: 先驱，真正的先驱。

sentences.en: They're not just pioneers.
sentences.zh: 他们不仅仅是先驱。

sentences.en: Their story is entwined with Levittowns.
sentences.zh: 他们的故事与莱威镇交织在一起。

sentences.en: Hilda's parents started their family in the States before deciding to come back home to the island.
sentences.zh: 希尔达的父母在合众国组建了家庭，之后决定回到岛上的家中。

sentences.en: Her uncle was working for the Levitt company, and he offered Hilda's father a job building the Levittown houses in Puerto Rico.
sentences.zh: 她的叔叔当时在莱威公司工作，他为希尔达的父亲提供了一份在波多黎各建造莱威镇房屋的工作。

sentences.en: Le ofreció trabajo y la oportunidad de comprarse su casita.
sentences.zh: 他提供了一份工作和买下自己小屋的机会。

sentences.en: And the opportunity for him to own his own home.
sentences.zh: 并为他提供了拥有自己房屋的机会。

sentences.en: Pues escogió este modelo.
sentences.zh: 于是他选择了这个户型。

sentences.en: Tres habitaciones, dos baños completos, marquesina, sala cocina y comedor.
sentences.zh: 三间卧室，两个完整的浴室，车棚，客厅、厨房和餐厅。

sentences.en: The houses are like so many others in Puerto Rican suburbs.
sentences.zh: 这些房子就像波多黎各郊区的许多其他房子一样。

sentences.en: Flat-roofed cement rectangles with Miami windows.
sentences.zh: 平顶的水泥矩形房子，配有迈阿密式窗户。

sentences.en: These had built-in planters and carports, marquesinas, framed in decorated cinder blocks.
sentences.zh: 这些房子有内置的花坛和车棚（marquesinas），四周是用装饰性煤渣砖围成的框架。

sentences.en: And the catalog really pushed the cinder blocks.
sentences.zh: 而且产品目录极力推崇这些煤渣砖。

sentences.en: Observe usted lo atractivo de los bloques ornamentales que resguardan el patio.
sentences.zh: 请看这些保护庭院的装饰性砖块是多么迷人。

sentences.en: Y las jardineras bajo las ventanas.
sentences.zh: 还有窗户下方的小花槽。

sentences.en: Mire cómo embellecen la fachada de esta magnífica residencia.
sentences.zh: 看它们是如何美化这座宏伟住宅的立面的。

sentences.en: All the homes came with new general electric appliances and were wired for telephones.
sentences.zh: 所有的房屋都配有全新的通用电气（General Electric）家电，并且预装了电话线。

sentences.en: In the 1960s, this was all a sleek, modern dream.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪60年代，这一切都是一个时髦、现代的梦想。

sentences.en: Esto aquí era un mangler.
sentences.zh: 这里以前是一片红树林。

sentences.en: Remember, this had been a mangrove swamp with lots of palm trees.
sentences.zh: 记住，这里曾经是一个长满棕榈树的红树林沼泽。

sentences.en: When Hilda's mother opened the front door, the marquesina, the carport, would be full of crabs.
sentences.zh: 当希尔达的母亲打开前门时，车棚（marquesina）里会布满螃蟹。

sentences.en: Están en la marquesina, están en el patio, están en la calle, están en la acera.
sentences.zh: 它们在车棚里，在院子里，在大街上，在人行道上。

sentences.en: Fue lo que abuela había dicho, hasta en la máquina de lavar ropa.
sentences.zh: 正如外祖母所说，甚至连洗衣机里都有。

sentences.en: A veces, mami, cuando prendía.
sentences.zh: 有时，妈妈，当它启动的时候。

sentences.en: Hilda's daughter, Paola, lives with her in Levitown.
sentences.zh: 希尔达的女儿宝拉和她一起住在莱威镇。

sentences.en: She's starting her career as a math teacher,
sentences.zh: 她正开始自己的数学老师职业生涯，

sentences.en: and she remembers that her grandmother had even found crabs in the washing machine.
sentences.zh: 她记得祖母甚至在洗衣机里也发现过螃蟹。

sentences.en: They'd get into the motor and rattle around if you turned it on.
sentences.zh: 如果你打开洗衣机，它们会钻进马达里发出嘎嘎的响声。

sentences.en: There were so many that people would collect them in metal buckets, clean them, and cook them.
sentences.zh: 数量实在是太多了，以至于人们会用金属桶把它们收集起来，清洗干净然后烹饪。

sentences.en: She'll never forget how many crab legs they ate.
sentences.zh: 她永远不会忘记他们吃掉了多少蟹腿。

sentences.en: The marquesinas were also where Sunday's service was held in the early days,
sentences.zh: 在早期，车棚也是举行主日礼拜的地方，

sentences.en: before Hilda's father, D'Antonio, helped to found the local Catholic parish.
sentences.zh: 在希尔达的父亲唐·托尼奥（Don Toño）帮助创立当地天主教堂之前。

sentences.en: Hilda was in the first graduating class of the elementary school, named for John F.
sentences.zh: 希尔达是小学的第一届毕业生，这所学校以约翰·F·肯尼迪的名字命名。

sentences.en: Kennedy.
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪。

sentences.en: There was a man-made lake, which still exists, but back then there were paddle boats, too.
sentences.zh: 这里有一个人工湖，至今仍然存在，不过当年那里还有脚踏船。

sentences.en: In the U.S., Levittowns were famous for excluding Black and Jewish homebuyers,
sentences.zh: 在美国，莱威镇因排斥黑人和犹太购房者而闻名，

sentences.en: and there were rules about everything from lawn maintenance to line-drying clothes.
sentences.zh: 而且从草坪维护到晾衣绳都有各种规章制度。

sentences.en: But there was none of that in Tua Baja.
sentences.zh: 但在托阿瓦哈却没有这些。

sentences.en: And in the late 70s, Hilda remembers a Levitown that was totally lit.
sentences.zh: 在7年代末，希尔达记忆中的莱威镇是一个充满活力、热闹非凡的地方。

sentences.en: Scouts with cars would drive around the different secciones
sentences.zh: 开着车的童子军会在不同的街区（secciones）巡视，

sentences.en: and report back about what parties were happening on a Friday night.
sentences.zh: 并汇报周五晚上有哪些派对正在举行。

sentences.en: A wedding, an anniversary, a birthday.
sentences.zh: 一场婚礼，一个周年纪念日，一个生日。

sentences.en: They'd arrive unannounced, get invited to join, and then they'd be the last to leave,
sentences.zh: 他们会不请自来，随后受到邀请加入，然后他们往往会成为最后一个离开的人，

sentences.en: dancing boleros all night long.
sentences.zh: 整夜跳着博莱罗（bolero）舞。

sentences.en: I like imagining my grandparents in this landscape, with Cheo Feliciano playing in the distance
sentences.zh: 我喜欢想象我的祖父母身处这片风景中，远处播放着切奥·费利西亚诺（Cheo Feliciano）的音乐，

sentences.en: and neighbors dancing in Marquesinas.
sentences.zh: 邻居们在车棚里跳着舞。

sentences.en: And maybe after so many years of hearing about the U.S.
sentences.zh: 也许在听了多年关于美国莱威镇的故事之后，

sentences.en: Levittowns,
sentences.zh: 莱威镇，

sentences.en: this is what success looked like to them.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们眼中成功该有的样子。

sentences.en: Life in a modern suburb, instead of a return to the lush but rustic countryside in Ciales.
sentences.zh: 生活在一个现代化的郊区，而不是回到西亚莱斯郁郁葱葱却又质朴的乡村。

sentences.en: And, as it turns out, that appeal of Levittown, it helps tell a bigger story
sentences.zh: 事实证明，莱威镇的这种吸引力，有助于讲述一个更宏大的故事：

sentences.en: about how in the mid-20th century, Puerto Rico's future ran headlong into the American dream.
sentences.zh: 即在20世纪中叶，波多黎各的未来是如何一头撞进美国梦的怀抱的。

sentences.en: That's Paula, Hilda's daughter again.
sentences.zh: 那是宝拉，希尔达的女儿。

sentences.en: Don Toño, her grandfather, knew a lot about Levittown's place in Puerto Rico's history.
sentences.zh: 她的祖父唐·托尼奥对莱威镇在波多黎各历史上的地位非常了解。

sentences.en: Porque Abuelo fue, pues, de esa generación, de que fue bien pobre, a, pues, realizarse.
sentences.zh: 因为外祖父属于那种非常贫穷、最终却实现梦想的一代人。

sentences.en: Y, por ejemplo, Abuelo no tenía zapatos.
sentences.zh: 比如，外祖父曾经连鞋子都没有。

sentences.en: He was from that generation, she says, that went from being really poor, he grew up without shoes,
sentences.zh: 她说，他是属于那种经历过极度贫困的一代人，他小时候光着脚长大，

sentences.en: to going on to get his high school degree later in life, and, of course, to own his own house.
sentences.zh: 后来在生活中才取得了高中学历，当然，还拥有了自己的房子。

sentences.en: Y hubo una política, yo creo, que de Luis Muñoz Marín, que era de eso.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为路易斯·穆尼奥斯·马林（Luis Muñoz Marín）当时推行过一项与之相关的政策。

sentences.en: Que la gente con él fue que tuvo sus primeros zapatos y cosas así.
sentences.zh: 正是在他的带领下，人们才穿上了第一双鞋之类的东西。

sentences.en: So, Luis Muñoz Marín, the first elected governor of Puerto Rico, is well known for pushing the idea
sentences.zh: 所以，路易斯·穆尼奥斯·马林，波多黎各第一位民选总督，以大力推行这样一个观点而闻名：

sentences.en: that the island's prosperity would come not from statehood and not by independence.
sentences.zh: 即岛上的繁荣既不是来自成为美国州份，也不是来自独立。

sentences.en: Muñoz advocated for a third way.
sentences.zh: 穆尼奥斯主张第三条道路。

sentences.en: Silvia Álvarez Curbelo is a Puerto Rican historian.
sentences.zh: 西尔维娅·阿尔瓦雷斯·库尔贝洛（Silvia Álvarez Curbelo）是一位波多黎各历史学家。
zh_words: 西尔维娅·阿尔瓦雷斯·库尔贝洛

sentences.en: She's also the author of Un País del Porvenir.
sentences.zh: 她也是《未来之国》（Un País del Porvenir）的作者。

sentences.en: Un País del Porvenir.
sentences.zh: 《未来之国》（Un País del Porvenir）。

sentences.en: The land of the future.
sentences.zh: 未来的土地。

sentences.en: Country of the future.
sentences.zh: 未来的国家。

sentences.en: Porvenir is a beautiful word.
sentences.zh: Porvenir是个美丽的词。

sentences.en: Porvenir means the time that is going to happen.
sentences.zh: Porvenir意味着将要发生的时间。

sentences.en: Like a point on the horizon.
sentences.zh: 就像地平线上的一个点。

sentences.en: Some kind of future of possibility.
sentences.zh: 某种充满可能性的未来。

sentences.en: And Puerto Rico has historically been eager, striving for modernity, she says.
sentences.zh: 她说，波多黎各历史上一直渴望并努力追求现代性。
